To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
optimal rule discovery (i) is more efficient than association rules, and (ii) is a special case of association rules.

optimal rule discovery can be used as an alternative to heuristic and association rule discovery and is significantly more efficient and more accurate than association rule discovery, particularly when the minimum support of association rule discovery is low.
optimal rule discovery can discover a family of globally optimal rules efficiently and is a promising alternative to association rule mining.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the discovery of optimal rules from a given database.
the problem of finding a family of globally optimal rule sets.
the development of a new framework for optimal rule discovery and its application to real data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed optimal rule discovery is the best rule discovery method in the sense that it is the most effective in terms of the number of rules, the accuracy of rules, the computational complexity and the efficiency of implementation.
heuristic and association rule discovery schemes are complementary to optimal rule discovery.

heuristic rule-discovery schemes are not as effective as association rule-discovery schemes when the number of rules is large, but association rule-discovery is not as efficient as heuristic rule-discovery when the number of discovered rules is large.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided a theoretical foundation for the discovery of globally optimal rules and demonstrated the feasibility of optimal rule discovery.
we have provided a new perspective for rule discovery.
optimal rule discovery provides a unified framework for discovering globally optimal rules, which are the most useful rules for decision making.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal rule discovery is a powerful and efficient alternative to the heuristic and association rule discovery.
optimal rule discovery can be applied to a variety of rule-discovery problems, such as nonreduct discovery and rule set generation.
